sources.name: mv12star/lista-telefonos-spam
sources.notes: Repository states that the list is compiled from multiple free web sources. Provenance of each underlying source must be preserved where available; do not treat the aggregate as proof that every upstream source permits redistribution. Import into Trash Stopper only after retaining source/version/hash metadata.

sources.name: alterine0101/rcs-spam-blocklist
sources.notes: RCS spam dataset. Use as a secondary signal; do not assume RCS abuse implies voice-call spam.

sources.name: FCC Consumer Complaints
sources.notes: Use aggregated complaint signals rather than treating a complaint as proof that a number belongs to a spammer.

sources.name: SysAdminDoc/CallShield database pipeline
sources.notes: Useful architecture and source-manifest model. Repository contains aggregated data from multiple upstream sources, so code/data rights must be evaluated independently.

excludedSources.name: Truecaller proprietary databases
excludedSources.reason: No scraping or unauthorized redistribution. Commercial use requires an explicit agreement.
